  • Participate in specialized conferences/meetings to increase knowledge as needed.
  • Regularly respond to registration requests and work with project teams to identify regulatory requirements.
  • Assist in the preparation of regulatory submissions and support summaries.
  • Ensure project/clinical site files and documents are developed, maintained, revised, archived and/or destroyed in accordance with project and regulatory requirements and that all project stakeholders are fully informed and trained on all applicable regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

  • Applicants should have a minimum of an undergraduate degree and 4-6 years of relevant experience in Clinical Research/Regulatory Affairs.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos de enfermagem e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior em Enfermagem completo.
  • Pós-Graduação completa em Auditoria em Saúde, Gestão Hospitalar, Saúde Pública ou áreas afins ou áreas correlatas.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

description:
About Web Summit

How did Web Summit become, in the words of Forbes, the best tech conference on the planet? Meaningful connections. Our tech events are unmissable because we make it easier for the right people to meet and connect. Everyone at Web Summit works towards this goal. And we’re just getting started. We’re always looking to build on the impact we have already made at Web Summit. In the coming years we’ll take Web Summit to new markets, promoting global connectivity, highlighting important issues and connecting global leaders – all while making a positive impact on the environment and communities we encounter. To build a better company, we have to better ourselves. We do that by finding the most ambitious people to work with us.

The role

We’re looking for a Creative Producer to join our growing Content Team for Web Summit Rio . You’ll be responsible for curating, shaping, and delivering high-calibre on-stage content. From speaker booking to on-site production, this is a fast-paced, high-impact role where editorial meets execution.

What you will do

  • Industry Research: Track trends, identify leading voices, and stay ahead of emerging startups and technologies across relevant industries.
  • Speaker Booking: Secure high-profile and A-list speakers, especially for our Centre Stage. You’ll lead outreach, negotiations, and coordination with speakers and their teams.
  • Editorial Ownership: Shape the narrative of our stages. Work with speakers to define compelling topics, formats, and titles. Write talk descriptions, moderator briefs, and technical scripts.
  • Live Production: Manage speaker logistics and live rehearsals. Ensure all assets are prepped and stages run smoothly on-site, collaborating with technical and production teams.
  • Platform & Data Management: Maintain accurate records using our internal platforms and tools. Attention to detail and flawless admin are essential to your success.
  • Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with speakers, companies, and stakeholders before, during, and after the event.
  • Internal Expertise: Be a source of insight and strategic advice for internal teams. You’ll act as the go-to expert for your speaker tracks and industries.

Skills and abilities we\'re looking for

  • You’re consistently booking high-quality, relevant speakers for Centre Stage and beyond.
  • You aim to confirm at least 4 A-list speakers per year across your content verticals.
  • You stay ahead of industry shifts and consistently maintain a strong research pipeline with timely, strategic outreach.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively with your manager, particularly around pipeline challenges.
  • You demonstrate strong editorial judgment , creating engaging formats and talk titles that resonate with our global audience.
  • You are a reliable team player who collaborates effectively across departments.
  • Your admin and data tracking are consistently up-to-date and accurate, supporting seamless internal operations.

Who you are

  • Ideally, 2–4 years of experience in production, content, editorial, or events (or adjacent industries)
  • Strong interest in tech, innovation, entrepreneurship, or media
  • Confident communicator with experience engaging high-profile individuals and companies
  • Exceptional organisational and writing skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with tools like CRMs, Google Suite, and other productivity platforms is a plus

Benefits and perks

  • Hybrid-working model open to all employees.
  • Fully subsidised healthcare, dental, employee assistance programme (EAP) and more.
  • Pension contribution up to 6% (Irish based only).
  • A dedicated in-house L&D department, with access to workshops, online learning and resources to help you excel in your career development.
  • Company laptop, generous annual leave and flexible working arrangements.
  • Our very own Tramway Team, which drives community and morale-boosting events for employees to participate in.
  • Annual company get-togethers, charity days, and monthly wellbeing talks.
  • Wellness subsidy issued to all employees of €1000 per year

At Web Summit, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We want talent from all walks of life to help us on our journey to digitise the conference sector. Hiring decisions are made purely on experience, skills and the needs of the business.

description:
Banco de Talentos para Pessoas com Deficiência

Da soma de todos os colaboradores que compõem nossos times, nascem nossos valores e visão de mundo. Aqui no IDG acreditamos no respeito à diversidade e à inclusão e, pensando nisso, esse banco de talentos é direcionado para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) . Para se candidatar é necessário que haja identificação com as características citadas. Caso você não pertença ao grupo descrito, você pode checar outras oportunidades na nossa página de carreiras.

Vale-Refeição e Vale-Alimentação: Disponibilizamos o cartão flexível Ticket Flex , podendo ser utilizado para as funções alimentação e refeição em qualquer estabelecimento com a bandeira Ticket;

Vale Transporte: De acordo com as regras da CLT;

Day off de aniversário: Uma folga para você comemorar o seu dia;

️ Assistência Médica com cobertura nacional da SulAmérica;

Assistência Odontológica Amil: Com ampla cobertura nacional, a adesão do plano é opcional;

Wellhub : Plataforma que oferece diversas redes de academias, estúdios e aplicativos de bem-estar;

Seguro de Vida Prudential: Proteção extra para sua família;

Vale Presente Natal: Valor creditado em um cartão presente para um Natal ainda mais acolhedor;

Convênio com empresas parceiras: Parcerias exclusivas para oferecer vantagens que fazem a diferença no dia a dia;

️ Acesso aos nossos Museus: Acesso gratuito aos nossos equipamentos culturais para você e sua família/amigos.

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais. Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CULTSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual, Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um. Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus. Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Overview

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. If you’re eager to collaborate globally, face challenges head-on, and make substantial impact, we’re looking for you to join our dynamic team.

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of advertising algorithms, personalization, and optimization… building the ML software and infrastructure that drives ad performance and user engagement at scale.

MUST HAVE

  • Excellent communication, teamwork, and project management skills

Your mission: Elevate Launch Potato’s advertising performance by building scalable, production-ready ML systems that optimize revenue while enhancing user experience. You’ll collaborate across teams to design, deploy, and refine algorithms that improve ad targeting, relevance, and efficiency at global scale.

OUTCOMES

  • Develop and scale advertising algorithms that optimize engagement and revenue simultaneously
  • Apply cutting-edge ML approaches (e.g., reinforcement learning, deep learning for ranking) to improve ad performance
  • Build scalable infrastructure to support real-time ad decisioning across millions of requests per day
  • Conduct rigorous experiments (A/B and multivariate tests) to measure model impact on business KPIs
  • Continuously improve ETL pipelines and monitoring systems to ensure reliable ad delivery
  • Collaborate with global teams across product, data, and engineering to launch high-impact ad features
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and integrate them into our ML stack when they create competitive advantage

COMPETENCIES

  • Impact-Oriented: You align ML systems to business outcomes and measure what matters

  • Collaborative: You work seamlessly with global teams and communicate complex ideas clearly
  • Resilient & Determined: You don’t shy from challenges and drive projects through to impact
  • Curious Innovator: You keep pace with ML/AI trends and creatively apply them to advertising
  • Analytical Problem-Solver: You break down complex systems and find data-driven solutions

title: LACTARISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Preparar fórmulas de composições lácteas, hídricas e dietas enterais a serem utilizadas nas diversas clínicas do Hospital, bem como efetuar a higienização de embalagens, bicos, mamadeiras e outros.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Médio completo

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Lactarista

Additional information

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho x 36 horas de descanso

Horário: 07:00 - 19:00 e/ou 19:00 - 07:00 (folguista)

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders. The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Executive Tournament Director

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

THE POSITION

The Executive Tournament Director, under the guidance of FIFA’s Chief Women’s Football Officer will be responsible for leading the team in Brazil tasked with the successful delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The Executive Tournament Director will represent FIFA in Brazil as the primary lead on all tournament related matters in close consultation and collaboration with the CBF, the Brazilian Government, State Governments, local authorities and the Brazilian Football stakeholders. In particular, the Tournament Director will ensure that the strategy, objectives and operational milestones for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 are achieved in a timely manner, within the agreed budgets and in accordance with all FIFA and Brazilian laws, rules and regulations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The Executive Tournament Director will be directly responsible for all administrative, commercial, financial, legal, communication and reporting matters related to the tournament guided by and in close collaboration with the relevant FIFA Chief Officers and the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will oversee and support the work of the Executive Operations Director to ensure that all operational milestones are delivered to a high standard, within agreed timeframes and within targeted financial parameters.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will also serve as a key representative and spokesperson for the event in Brazil, effectively engaging with stakeholders, participants, and media to promote its mission and values in close collaboration with the Chief Women’s Football Officer and Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will form part of the FWWC2027 Senior Leadership Team together with the FIFA Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup and the FIFA27 Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring effective delivery from all Departments and key functional areas involved in the tournament delivery in close collaboration with the Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring seamless collaboration and reporting into the FIFA Leadership.

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in leading roles in sports event management and delivery.
  • Proven track record in international event delivery with clear achievement of KPIs on budget, event objectives and operational milestones.
  • Experience in working with the Brazilian Federal and State Governments.
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Clear experience in managing multi-million-dollar event budgets.
  • Experience in managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Ability to effectively monitor employees’ organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.
  • Have the following strengths: high energy levels, entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Competent IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes (project management certification such as PRINCE2 or PMP an advantage).
  • Experience and knowledge of the local culture and political structures in Brazil.
  • Experience of working in football is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\u2019s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Overview

Grade: P-5

Job Posting: September 4, 2025

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise

  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.

Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You'll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer

Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure DevOps practices, raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a model-driven approach, whether on-premise or on public clouds.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes clusters, and applications for customers across both physical and public cloud estates. We identify and address incidents, monitor and observe applications, anticipate potential issues, and enable product refinement to ultimately achieve high-quality standards in our open source portfolio.

To succeed in this role, you need to have a strong background in Linux, Python, networking, and knowledge of how clouds work. Your work will encompass the entire stack, from bare-metal networking and kernel up to Kubernetes and open source applications. You can expect to be trained in our core technologies like OpenStack, Kubernetes, security standards, open source products like Kubeflow, Kafka, OpenSearch, databases, and many others.

Automation for us is a software engineering problem that we approach with a scientific mindset to bring operations at scale, driven by metrics and code.

Location: Globally remote role

Role

We deploy and run OpenStack, Kubernetes, storage solutions, and open source applications, applying DevOps practices.

To become a member of our team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from bare metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in operations with mission-critical services for global brand-name customers.

As a member of the team, you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure.

What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in software engineering or computer science
  • Python software development experience
  • Operational experience in Linux environments
  • Experience with Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Bonus skills

  • Familiarity with OpenStack deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public cloud deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with private cloud management

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Every 6 months compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet your colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Training Site Infrastructure Manager

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA\'s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor\'s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\'s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Atividades

  • Realizar todas as atividades mantendo o alinhamento às premissas de sustentabilidade visando atender aos requisitos das Políticas ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance - Ambiental, Social e Governança) da Companhia; atender as metas definidas de acordo com sua área de atuação.
  • Assumir o plantão conforme a regra institucional, e assumir a circulação da sala operatória sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Realizar a abertura do livro de ordens e ocorrências de enfermagem da sala no início de cada plantão, realizar o preenchimento do check list de temperatura e materiais, testagem e conferência do parque tecnológico, assim como iluminação, gases medicinais e rede de vácuo da sala.
  • Conferir no início de cada plantão a programação cirúrgica de sua sala, autorização do procedimento e OPME, realizar a montagem da sala, providenciar os materiais necessários segundo as especificidades de cada intervenção anestésico cirúrgico, incluindo materiais consignados, especiais e confirmação de reservas (UTI, hemoderivados, etc).
  • Realizar todas as etapas do protocolo de cirurgia segura e garantir as metas internacionais de segurança do paciente.
  • Realizar todo o processo no sistema blochos de solicitar e receber o paciente, iniciar e pré-finalizar a cirurgia.
  • Admitir o paciente na porta de entrada do centro cirúrgico, quando essa atividade não puder ser realizada pelo enfermeiro.
  • Auxiliar o cliente no transporte da maca para a mesa cirúrgica, assim como em seu posicionamento, procurando manter sua privacidade e a permeabilidade de cateteres e sondas.
  • Desenvolver procedimentos técnicos como punção venosa e outros, conforme orientação do enfermeiro e na ausência deste.
  • Auxiliar o anestesiologista na indução anestésica e na reversão do procedimento anestésico na ausência do enfermeiro.
  • Fixar a placa dispersiva de energia do eletro cautério no paciente e manusear corretamente os equipamentos.
  • Auxiliar na paramentação da equipe cirúrgica e utilizar corretamente as técnicas assépticas para abertura dos materiais estéreis.
  • Prestar assistência ao paciente e à equipe durante o ato anestésico cirúrgico e manter boas relações no trabalho com a equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Realizar a conferência do hemoderivado antes da entrega ao médico solicitante. Solicitar a entrega ao serviço de hemoterapia. Realizar o controle e registro da temperatura enquanto permanecer no setor em frasqueira apropriada.
  • Realizar todo o processo no sistema blochos de solicitar o paciente, iniciar e pré finalizar o procedimento e inserir os lacres de OPME.
  • Prestar assistência ao técnico do procedimento anestésico - cirúrgico, auxiliando na transferência do paciente da mesa cirúrgica para a maca, realizando inspeção física para detectar possíveis eventos adversos. Posicionar adequadamente drenos, infusões, sondas, para posterior encaminhamento a devida unidade. Solicitar a presença do enfermeiro em situações imprevistas ou emergenciais.
  • Realizar evolução de enfermagem e garantir as informações do paciente na transferência de cuidados através do método SBAR para outras unidades.
  • Preencher a planilha de reserva de UTI no dia que antecede a programação cirúrgica na ausência do enfermeiro. Apenas plantão SN.
  • Realizar agendamento de cirurgias de emergência no WPD, módulo Blochos, reservar a sala, solicitar opmes para os fornecedores autorizados, e providenciar todos os materiais, recursos necessários, reserva de UTI e hemoderivados se necessário na ausência do enfermeiro.
  • Realizar a identificação das peças anatomo-patológicas, conferir pedidos e registros em livro próprio. Encaminhar 2x ao dia (10 e 16 horas). Encaminhar cultura imediatamente ao término do procedimento, juntamente com o pedido médico. E liberação de peças para o patologista ou laboratório externo, apenas mediante assinatura em livro de protocolo de histopatológico. O acondicionamento das peças deverá ser realizado conforme a orientação médica.
  • Garantir o preenchimento de todos os impressos de rotina do setor, assegurar todas as devidas cobranças, bem como os registros médicos em sua totalidade. Conferir os acréscimos de procedimentos e opmes, evitando impacto financeiro na instituição.
  • Comunicar ao enfermeiro a necessidade de reparos, ou manutenção de equipamentos da sala operatória. Realizar abertura de chamado para engenharia corretiva de equipamentos biomédicos e materiais de suporte na ausência do técnico diarista ou enfermeiro, e nos casos de urgência. Assim como para serviços de manutenção e informática. Realizar a liberação dos equipamentos através registro em livro de protocolo.
  • Realizar a desmontagem da sala ao término do procedimento cirúrgico, encaminhar os materiais contaminados a setor de CME conforme rotina institucional, realizar a devolução dos materiais e medicamentos não utilizados na farmácia satélite identificado e providenciar a limpeza da sala.
  • Atuar na rastreabilidade dos instrumentais, materiais ou equipamentos cirúrgicos. Zelar pelo parque tecnológico, armazenando de forma limpa e segura.
  • Notificar eventos adversos, sentinelas e não conformidades ocorridas no âmbito cirúrgico e hospitalar.
  • Participar dos treinamentos e programas de aprimoramento oferecidos pela instituição ou outros.

Tecnico de AC/Refrigeracao Senior

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Refrigeração com foco marítimo que vai atuar na instalação, comissionamento, manutenção e reparo de chillers, plantas de provisão, unidades de refrigeração e sistemas HVAC especificamente projetados para ambientes marítimos. Este papel exige um conhecimento profundo de sistemas de refrigeração complexos e uma forte habilidade para gerenciar os desafios técnicos únicos dos sistemas de refrigeração.

Responsabilidades Principais:

· Instalar, comissionar e manter chillers industriais, plantas de refrigeração de provisão e sistemas HVAC em embarcações marítimas e em instalações marítimas.

· Realizar manutenção rotineira e de emergência em sistemas de refrigeração e ar condicionado, garantindo que operem com eficiência máxima e atendam aos padrões ambientais e de segurança.

· Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em uma variedade de sistemas, focando em chillers e unidades de refrigeração, enquanto mantém proficiência com componentes de sistemas HVAC.

· Reformar compressores e outros componentes críticos dentro desses sistemas, melhorando sua confiabilidade e desempenho.

· Colaborar com engenheiros marítimos para otimizar layouts e cronogramas de refrigeração, minimizando o tempo de inatividade e a interferência operacional.

· Manter documentação precisa e detalhada de todos os procedimentos técnicos, modificações de sistemas e verificações de conformidade.

· Fornecer orientação e treinamento especializados para técnicos juniores, enfatizando as especificidades de chillers, plantas de provisão e sistemas de refrigeração em um contexto marítimo.

· Manter-se atualizado com os avanços tecnológicos em sistemas de refrigeração marítima e HVAC, integrando novas técnicas e equipamentos em estruturas existentes.

Qualificações:

· Experiência como Técnico de Refrigeração com conhecimento especializado em refrigeração, incluindo chillers, plantas de provisão e unidades de refrigeração em grande escala.

· Proficiência na instalação, comissionamento, diagnóstico de problemas e reforma de sistemas de refrigeração complexos, com experiência adicional em tecnologias HVAC.

· Certificações relevantes em Refrigeração e HVAC, com treinamento ou certificações adicionais voltadas para aplicações marítimas, são preferidas.

· Fortes habilidades técnicas, incluindo a capacidade de interpretar esquemas detalhados e manuais operacionais específicos para sistemas de refrigeração e HVAC marítimos.

· Habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas, com foco na resolução rápida e eficiente de questões técnicas em ambientes marítimos desafiadores.

· Inglês intermediário, e um diferencial

· Disposição para viajar por longos períodos, se necessário.

· Proficiência na utilização de ferramentas como MS Office ( Word, Excel) para realização de relatórios técnicos e de serviço.

Condições de Trabalho:

Este papel exige trabalhar em variados ambientes marítimos, que podem ser fisicamente exigentes e às vezes perigosos. Os técnicos precisam se adaptar às condições restritas e dinâmicas encontradas em navios e instalações portuárias. Horários de trabalho flexíveis, incluindo possíveis turnos noturnos e de fim de semana, são frequentemente necessários para acomodar os cronogramas operacionais dos clientes marítimos.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Atendimento
description:
Job description

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Overview

Faça Parte do Time Med+ e Transforme Vidas!

Se você é um profissional comprometido, apaixonado pela área da saúde e segurança e deseja fazer a diferença, o Grupo Med+ é o lugar certo para você!

Somos movidos pela missão de salvar vidas e acreditamos profundamente em nosso propósito de transformar a terceirização de mão de obra no Brasil, convertendo recursos humanos em pessoas felizes.

Somos referência nacional no fornecimento de terceirização de Emergency Response para infraestruturas críticas, atuando em três pilares essenciais: Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho, Urgência e Emergência, Prevenção e combate a incêndios.

Você se identifica com a nossa empresa? Então essa é a sua chance!

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e ser um Med Member.

Apoiar nas áreas de prontidão, atendimento e resposta a emergências, salvamento e resgate, atividades de prevenção e demandas de rotina nas instalações das Usinas do Parque Termoelétrico da Petrobras.

Responsabilidades

  • Manter a disponibilidade dos materiais e equipamentos de atendimento a emergência em perfeito estado de conservação, higienização e organização.
  • Compor a Brigada de Emergência da CONTRATANTE e atender a situações de emergências nas instalações da CONTRATANTE ou na circunvizinhança, quando a Unidade for participante de PAM (Plano de Auxílio Mútuo entre CONTRATANTE/CONTRATADA).
  • Elaborar e ministrar treinamentos relativos à prevenção, preparação e resposta a emergências, e treinamentos relacionados a SMS, bem como formar multiplicadores, conforme instrução e procedimentos da PETROBRAS, dentro da área de serviço quando necessário e solicitado pela Fiscalização da PETROBRAS.
  • Participar de treinamentos relativos à prevenção, preparação e resposta a emergências, e treinamentos relacionados a SMS conforme orientações da CONTRATANTE.
  • Executar inspeção dos recursos e equipamentos de prevenção e combate a incêndio, emergências químicas e ambientais da CONTRATADA.
  • Elaborar o planejamento das atividades previstas para o período de medição e alimentar os sistemas informatizados definidos pela CONTRATANTE.
  • Participar do Plano de Auxílio Mútuo - PAM (quando aplicável), compondo a equipe de atendimento em conjunto com a CONTRATANTE ou individualmente.
  • Apoiar nas atividades relacionadas ao planejamento, prontidão e resgate técnico em altura e espaço confinado.
  • Planejar, instalar e remover equipamentos de apoio em trabalhos críticos em altura e em espaços confinados, bem como atuação em busca, salvamento e resgate, possibilitando o atendimento nas frentes de trabalho.
  • Realizar serviços de resgate técnico de pessoas, com mão-de-obra especializada, durante as atividades de paradas de unidades de processo.
  • Determinar os pontos de ancoragem seguros a serem utilizados nas operações de resgate.
  • Planejar e supervisionar salvamento e resgate, bem como elaborar treinamentos e ministrá-los conforme instrução e procedimentos da PETROBRAS.
  • Acompanhar a execução do planejamento da montagem e desmontagem de andaimes em área industrial, avaliando as condições de segurança para liberação das estruturas montadas.
  • Inspecionar periodicamente os andaimes existentes, utilizados nos serviços de rotina, pré-parada, parada de manutenção e pós-parada de manutenção.
  • Inspecionar e monitorar o isolamento de área de movimentação de cargas, a fim de evitar que os colaboradores adentrem no raio de abrangência da carga.
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento do procedimento Padrão Corporativo da área de Negócio ou da Unidade de Negócio (RGN/UTE) de montagem e desmontagem de andaimes, o qual tem o objetivo de padronizar as atividades de montagem e desmontagem, manutenção e segurança de andaimes, além do Padrão sobre Segurança nos Trabalhos em Altura.
  • Realizar avaliações pré-determinadas e auditar as atividades em espaços confinados ou restritos com monitoramento ambiental com uso de aparelhos multigases e de estresse térmico fornecidos pela CONTRATANTE, gerando suporte ao técnico de segurança do trabalho da CONTRATANTE, com registro em formulário próprio.
  • Executar o plano de inspeções e auditorias nas fases da parada;
  • Inspecionar ferramentas e máquinas de empresas contratadas, identificando com selo específico os aprovados;
  • Facilitar, acompanhar e realizar Diálogo Diário de Segurança – DDS nas diversas equipes e frentes de serviços;
  • Apoiar na elaboração e acompanhamento da implementação das Análises de Riscos (AR) das atividades rotineiras e nas diversas fases da Parada de Manutenção;
  • Liberação de permissões de trabalho;
  • Apoiar na implementação da sistemática para a gestão dos desvios e incidentes nas Paradas Programadas das Usinas Termelétricas, bem como aplicar as estratégias de disseminação de conhecimento e treinamento;
  • Atender outras solicitações da PETROBRAS, concernente à sua área de serviços de Bombeiro Profissional Civil, salvamento e Resgate.

Qualificações e Formação

  • O profissional deve possuir meio de transporte próprio ou algum transporte particular que permita a sua ida ao local de trabalho.
  • Formação: Nível médio Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Qualificação técnica em atendimento a NBR 14608 quanto ao conteúdo mínimo e carga horária.
  • Treinamento de reciclagem bienal conforme estabelecido na mesma NBR ou em intervalo inferior quando definido pela legislação pertinente;
  • Qualificação técnica no nível de líder em Regaste conforme NBR 16710, atendendo ao conteúdo mínimo programático e carga horária de 32h.
  • Treinamento de reciclagem bianual conforme estabelecido na mesma NBR;
  • Capacitação para resgate em altura e espaço confinado em atendimento a NR-33 e NBR 16710;
  • Capacitação conforme NR 20 - Segurança e Saúde nos Trabalhos com Inflamáveis e Combustíveis (treinamento Avançado II - 32h) e respectivo treinamento periódico (reciclagem ou atualização);
  • Capacitação conforme NR 33 - Espaço Confinado (Trabalhador autorizado e/ou Equipe de emergência – 32hs) e respectivo treinamento periódico (reciclagem ou atualização);
  • Capacitação conforme NR 35 - Trabalho em Altura (8h) e respectivo treinamento periódico (reciclagem ou atualização);
  • Capacitação conforme Curso básico NR-10 (40h) e respectivo treinamento periódico (reciclagem ou atualização);
  • Habilitação categoria D ou categoria superior e curso de Condutor de veículo de emergência conforme Res. 168/CONTRAN (50h) para condução de viaturas tipo AB-Auto Bomba, AHQ-Auto Hidro Químico (com PBT>45 ton.), AR-Auto Resgate, viaturas leves, caminhões pipa e outras designadas.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Ajuda de Custo (auxilio combustível), deverá ser ofertado R$ 4,10 para cada 7kms rodados, considerando a distância de casa x trabalho x casa, limitando o valor máximo de R$ 500,00.

Obs. O profissional deve residir em um perímetro máximo de 30 km da unidade de atendimento.

Com mais de 6.000 colaboradores espalhados por todo o território nacional, a nossa missão é proteger e cuidar da vida de mais de 56 milhões de pessoas que transitam diariamente por aeroportos, rodovias, shoppings, escolas, empresas, mineradoras e petrolíferas.

title: Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine
description:
Career Opportunities with Community Health Centers of the Central Coast

A great place to work.

Careers At Community Health Centers of the Central Coast

Share with friends or Subscribe!

Are you ready for new challenges and new opportunities?

Join our team!

Current job opportunities are posted here as they become available.

Subscribe to our RSS feeds to receive instant updates as new positions become available.

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine

Wage Range that the Company Expects to Pay: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly

SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results the Physician provides primary healthcare services for Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC), and to perform related work as required.

It is the primary purpose of CHC to provide the highest quality of total care possible to the patient population it serves. Such a level of quality depends ultimately on the staffs desire and ability to work together, individually, and as a team. The employee is expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic at all times.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Duties assigned by the Chief Medical Officer include, but are not limited to, the following activities and may be adjusted based on patient and clinic medical service requirements:

Secures and evaluates a patient's health history and records findings in a systematic, accurate and succinct manner.

Performs a physical assessment and is able to discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.

Provides routine physical examinations, diagnostic services and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.

Adheres to the highest standards of medical ethics at all times.

Assures quality of care for all patients.

Shares on-call duties, when indicated, with other members of the medical staff.

Elicits and records information about patient's medical history.

Examines patient to determine general physical condition.

Orders or executes various tests, analyses, and diagnostic images to provide information on patient's condition.

Analyzes reports and findings of tests and of examination, and diagnoses condition.

Administers or prescribes treatments and drugs.

Inoculates and vaccinates patients to immunize patients from communicable diseases.

Advises patients concerning diet, hygiene, and methods for prevention of disease.

Reports births, deaths, and outbreak of contagious diseases to governmental authorities.

Refers patients to medical specialist or other practitioner for specialized treatment.

Conducts physical examinations to provide information needed for admission to school, consideration for jobs, or eligibility for insurance coverage.

Assists the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies, evaluating existing policies and developing changes in policies as necessary; designing, implementing, and evaluating education programs for patients and staff.

Shares supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required.

Works within privileges and protocols as established by the Chief Medical Officer.

Participates in committees as requested by the Chief Medical Officer.

Demonstrates adherence to and observes all safety policies and procedures, inclusive of infection control rules and regulations.

Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served (infants, pediatrics, adolescent, adults or geriatrics).

Demonstrates knowledge of domestic violence, child, and dependent and elder abuse protocols.

Maintains and adheres to HIPAA, confidential and privileged communications (patient, employees, and corporation).

Participates in patient population management as it relates to clinical services while taking into account cultural diversity and local resources.

Participates in the team member's care coordination by providing follow up phone calls post hospital discharge, Assists the patient with follow up appointments within the recommended time frames and gather data from recent hospital admissions to facilitate follow up.

Understands the role in self-management support by developing a relationship with high risk clients and anticipate what needs they may encounter. Develop the ability to refer to an RN when clinical judgment is in question.

Develop communication skills with all members of the team both internal and external, by first being a patient advocate and use the available resources to facilitate care. Coordinate with the Care Team (PCP, RN, Health Educator, LCSW, Director of Nursing and/or Chief Medical Officer) to ensure appropriate services are arranged for the patient in order for them to meet their goals.

Understand the role in the quality improvement process which may include meetings, data collection and charge auditing. Use Evidence Based Practice guidelines to assist with disease management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Medical Doctor Degree (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school. Completion of a residency training program in the field Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics, required. Board Certified or board eligibility required. Maintains current knowledge in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics through continuing medical education, participation in local and national medical societies.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret the most complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries or complaints. Bilingual (English and Spanish) ability to speak, read, write Spanish desirable.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to interpret bar graphs.

REASONING ABILITY

Authoritative knowledge of the principles, practice and techniques of family-centered medicine. Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Possession of current unrestricted and valid License - Physician and Surgeon or equivalent from Medical Board of California. Board Certified/Eligible Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics, required. Possession of current unrestricted and valid DEA license, Advanced Cardio Life Support (ACLS) for FP/IM, Pediatric

Advanced Life Support (PALS) card for PEDS; and Basic Life Support (BLS-C) card for all specialties.

Annual health examination; annual TB skin test clearance or biannual chest x-ray, and up to date immunizations for health care workers at time of hire and annually thereafter.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Must be willing to have a flexible work schedule that may include late evenings and weekends, and be able to travel to other clinic sites or locations as needed.
